name: Next AI Draw.io
description: Draws and edits draw.io diagrams from chat prompts, images, or documents for engineers and analysts, via web app, desktop app, or MCP server.

skills.name: Prompt to Diagram
skills.description: Generates architecture diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and more from one sentence, with AWS, Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes icons.

skills.name: Edit Selection
skills.description: Changes only the shapes selected on the canvas and highlights what the AI modified.

skills.name: Image and File to Diagram
skills.description: Redraws an uploaded screenshot or sketch, or diagrams the content of PDF, Markdown, or code files.

skills.name: Version History
skills.description: Saves every AI change as a version that can be compared with the canvas, restored, or undone.

skills.name: Diagram Export
skills.description: Exports diagrams as .drawio, .png, .svg, or .drawio.svg files at any time.
